description: Set a variable's value for a mode, or bind it to a node property or local style (styleId + field). Text styles bind font/spacing fields; paint styles bind 'paints'. Verified by readback (BIND_NOT_APPLIED otherwise). width/height on an instance sublayer: INSTANCE_SUBLAYER_RESTRICTED, bind the master.

field.description: Property or text field (fontSize, lineHeight, letterSpacing, paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent, fontFamily, fontStyle, fontWeight), or 'paints' for paint styles

nodeId.description: Node to bind to (a style id here routes to the style path)

paintIndex.description: Paint index for fills, strokes or a paint style

styleId.description: Local style id (e.g. "S:abc123") to bind a TEXT or PAINT style, instead of nodeId

value.description: number, string, boolean or color object

name: figma_set_variable
